GPT-6 Sol just landed on Arena. OpenAI’s latest model is available in Direct Mode ( https://arena.ai/code/direct?model_a=gpt-6-sol&utm_source=email&utm_medium=cta_high&utm_campaign=gpt6sol&utm_content=text ) for the next 24 hours.

Bring it something you’re working on. Ask it to debug code, dig into a research question, draft something from scratch, or take on a task you’ve been saving for a stronger model.

Select GPT-6 Sol in Direct Mode and see how it handles it.

Available in Arena until September 29 at 9am PT.

Best,
Arena Team
